# Sri Hanuman Jyothishyalayam

> Vedic astrology and Vastu consultations with Pandit Sri Pandu Ranga Shastri Ji,
> offered from three centres in India: Bengaluru, Hyderabad and Mumbai.
> Guidance is given without guaranteed-outcome claims.

## Key facts

- Practitioner: Pandit Sri Pandu Ranga Shastri Ji, Vedic astrologer and Vastu consultant, 30+ years of practice.
- Languages: English, Telugu, Kannada, Hindi, Marathi.
- Consultation formats: in person at all three centres, or online by call/video.
- The practice does not sell gemstones, yantras or remedial products.
- The practice does not offer vashikaran, curse removal or any service claiming to influence another person's will.
- No outcome is guaranteed; remedies are suggested only where a chart indicates them.

## Centres

- Bengaluru — 504, 9th Cross Road, 8th Main Road, Sadashiva Nagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560080
- Hyderabad — 3rd Floor, Hanuman General Superstore Building, MIG-273, Omni Hospital Line, Balaji Nagar, Kukatpally, Hyderabad, Telangana 500072
- Mumbai — No. 6, Kohinoor Corner, Scheme No. IV, Swatantryaveer Savarkar Road, Prabhadevi, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400025

## Services

- [Kundli Matching](https://shreehanumanjyothis.in/services/kundli-matching/): Ashtakoot Guna Milan, 36-point system.
- [Jataka Matching (Porutham)](https://shreehanumanjyothis.in/services/jataka-matching/): South Indian ten-Porutham method.
- [Kundli Reading](https://shreehanumanjyothis.in/services/kundli-reading/): full birth chart analysis.
- [Marriage & Relationship Guidance](https://shreehanumanjyothis.in/services/marriage-guidance/)
- [Love & Relationship Guidance](https://shreehanumanjyothis.in/services/relationship-guidance/)
- [Prasna Jyotish](https://shreehanumanjyothis.in/services/prasna-jyotish/): one question, no birth details required.
